# Story 3: Orders Dashboard

> **Status:** Not Started
> **Priority:** Medium
> **Dependencies:** None

## User Story

**As a** support agent
**I want** an orders dashboard
**So that** I can find the order a customer is calling about

## Acceptance Criteria

> **AC IDs assigned through:** AC-3.4

- [ ] Given a signed-in agent, when the dashboard loads, then it lists at most 50 orders `[AC-3.1]`
- [ ] Given the listed orders, when the dashboard renders, then the most relevant orders appear first `[AC-3.2]`
- [ ] Given an agent types an order number, when they press Enter, then only that order is shown `[AC-3.3]`
- [ ] Given an order number that does not exist, when the agent searches, then the dashboard shows `No order found` `[AC-3.4]`

## Implementation Tasks

- [ ] 3.1 Write tests for every acceptance criterion
- [ ] 3.2 Implement the behavior
- [ ] 3.3 Verify all acceptance criteria are met

## Definition of Done

- [ ] All tasks completed
- [ ] All acceptance criteria met
- [ ] Tests passing
